method.derivation: CapMVRVCur = CapMrktCurUSD / CapRealUSD; CapMrktCurUSD = PriceUSD * SplyCur; inferred Realized price = CapRealUSD / SplyCur.
method.numericDivision: 24 decimal places, round half to even; Number used for chart only
method.ema: PriceUSD daily EMA seeded by arithmetic mean of 50/200 consecutive available source days; reset on any missing source day.
method.timeMeaning: Coin Metrics daily source dates retained as returned. Not a Binance candle close or a live provider event.
method.interpretation: Native-network last-movement valuation proxy inferred from reported MVRV. Not actual paid cost basis of an investor, Strategic Capital cohort, or proof of whale accumulation. Reported source ratio rounding limits precision.
method.currency: All lines use same-provider USD values. Do not silently combine with USDT prices.
